北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴冷，体感 -5℃！注意保暖，别感冒哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny but chilly, feels like -5℃! Stay warm to avoid colds.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，体感 9℃。记得添衣，心情也要美美的！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy, feels like 9℃. Remember to add clothes and keep your spirits up!
慈溪.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，气温 13℃。注意添衣，别着凉啦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, 13℃. Remember to add clothes and don't catch a cold!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天 23℃，体感舒适。享受这惬意的天气吧！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and a comfy 23℃. Enjoy this pleasant weather!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳有雾，湿度 75%。开车注意慢行，保持好心情！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is foggy with 75% humidity. Drive carefully and stay cheerful!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴冷 10℃，湿度 92%。注意防潮，多喝热水哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and cool 10℃, 92% humidity. Mind the dampness, drink more hot water!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 10℃。早晚温差大，别感冒了！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy, feels like 10℃. Mind the temperature difference, don't catch a cold!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天 14℃，体感舒适。记得多喝水，保持好状态！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and 14℃, feels comfortable. Remember to drink water and stay well!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉小雨 9℃，湿度 95%。出门带伞，注意防潮保暖。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has light rain 9℃, 95% humidity. Take an umbrella, stay dry and warm.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天 9℃，体感微凉。多喝水润润喉，注意保暖。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and 9℃, feels slightly cool. Drink water to soothe your throat, stay warm.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天 14℃，体感 11℃。注意添衣，保持好心情！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and 14℃, feels like 11℃. Remember to layer up and stay cheerful!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨 -18℃，体感 -22℃！超级冷，务必穿厚实些！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is -18℃, feels like -22℃! Extremely cold, make sure to bundle up very warmly!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -22℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗 -12℃，体感 -17℃。小心冻伤，注意防风保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny -12℃, feels like -17℃. Watch out for frostbite, stay warm and windproof.
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -17℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云 16℃，体感舒适。微风习习，享受好天气！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and 16℃, feels comfortable. Gentle breeze, enjoy the nice weather!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云 19℃，体感宜人。愿你一天都有好心情！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and 19℃, feels pleasant. Hope you have a good day!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴冷 4℃，体感 -6℃！风力大，注意防风保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and cold 4℃, feels like -6℃! Windy, mind the wind and stay warm.
青岛.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云 -8℃，体感 -14℃！风力 5级，务必穿厚点！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy -8℃, feels like -14℃! Wind force 5, be sure to dress very warmly!
